newsitem.title: UK: BFI dips by three points to 1,513, activity slow.
newsitem.headline: BFI dips by three points to 1,513, activity slow.

text.p: Holidays in Japan and South Korea kept the freight market at a low ebb on Thursday.
The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was fixed down three at 1,513 a generally quiet market

Brokers described Panamax conditions in the U.S. as very firm but less predictable in the Far East. Little Caper business was reported, though brokers believe that demand for these types will grow in most areas near-term.
